name: com.serpgrab/google-search
title: serpgrab: Google Search, Maps and Jobs
description: Real-time Google search (AI Overview, People also ask), Maps and Jobs. API key or x402 per call.

tools.name: google_search
tools.description: Real-time Google web results: title, URL, date and snippet for each result, plus the AI Overview, answer box, knowledge panel, local pack, ads and "People also ask" when Google shows them. Question-style queries ("how do I...", "what is...") usually get an AI Overview. Each page read is one billed search, so use pages=1 unless you need more. Usually 2-6 s per page. Without an API key, pay per call in USDC on Base with x402 (the first call answers with the price).

query.description: The search, as typed into Google.

pages.description: Result pages to read (about 10 results each), 1-3. Default 1.

country.description: Two-letter country code Google searches from (gl), e.g. "us", "gb", "de". Default "us".

location.description: Search as if from this place, e.g. "Austin, Texas, United States". Leave out for a country-wide search.

time.description: Only results from the past hour, day, week, month or year.

tools.name: google_maps_search
tools.description: Businesses and places from Google Maps, 20 per page: name, type, rating and review count, price, address, phone, hours, website, coordinates and place_id. Put the place in the query ("plumber in denver co") or pass ll. Each page is one billed search. Without an API key, pay per call in USDC on Base with x402 (the first call answers with the price).

query.description: What to look for, e.g. "pizza in austin tx".

country.description: Two-letter country code Google searches from (gl), e.g. "us", "gb", "de". Default "us".

tools.name: google_jobs_search
tools.description: Job listings from Google Jobs, 10 per page: title, company, location, salary, schedule, when posted, job highlights (qualifications, benefits, responsibilities), the description and direct apply links (Indeed, LinkedIn, company sites). Pass location for a city ("Chicago, Illinois, United States"); Google localises jobs to it. For the next 10, call again with the same query and location plus the next_page_token from the previous answer. Each page is one billed search. Without an API key, pay per call in USDC on Base with x402 (the first call answers with the price).

query.description: The job search, e.g. "leasing consultant" or "property manager".

location.description: Search as if from this place, e.g. "Chicago, Illinois, United States".

next_page_token.description: From the previous answer, for the next 10 jobs. Keep query and location the same.

page.description: Only numbers the jobs in the answer (page 2 starts at 11); paging itself is next_page_token.

country.description: Two-letter country code Google searches from (gl), e.g. "us", "gb", "de". Default "us".
